issue_context.title: sql, bulkio: support backup restore for system.privileges table
issue_context.body:
Currently `system.privileges` is opt out of full cluster restores meaning certain privileges are not restored.

We should opt it in, there shouldn't be much work to do other than validating the privilege path.

Jira issue: CRDB-17851
Epic CRDB-11725

review_comments: ✅ Double checked that it looks like the format for the `path` element in the table also doesn't use any IDs that need rewritting.
